select: select b.id as menu_id, b.name, b.menu_code , b.menu_icon, REPLACE(b.menu_url, '/', '') as menu_url, b.parent_id from jml_menu b where b.show_front = '1' and b.enable = '1' and b.show_wxapp = '1' and exists( select a.id from jml_role_menu a inner join jml_staff_role c on a.role_id = c.role_id where b.id = a.menu_id and a.enable = '1' and c.enable = '1' and c.staff_id = #{staffId} ) order by b.sort desc
